name: CommuteAssistTramStop

custom.system_prompt: You are generating an ultra-short tram commute scene. A person on a tram asks their assistant which stop to get off at. Sigma answers in one sentence. Done.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Tram interior sounds, city tram rumble, bell, stop announcement, urban transit

initial_prompt: Generate an ultra-short tram commute. The person is riding a tram and isn't sure which stop to get off at for their destination. They ask Sigma. Sigma gives the stop name. Person reacts with a word or nothing.

setting.background: On the tram, destination in mind but not sure exactly which stop is closest.
setting.conversation_style: One quiet question, one answer, done.

scenario_template.topic: Person asks which tram stop is closest to their destination
scenario_template.note: Under 70 chars. Quiet voice. E.g. 'Sigma, which stop for the gallery?' or 'Sigma, where do I get off for Canal Street?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma gives the stop name. Person notes it.
scenario_template.note: Sigma: stop name, maybe one landmark. One sentence. Person: 'okay' or nothing.

user1.name: Aisha
user1.role: Tram commuter, slightly unsure of the stop. Speaks quietly on public transport.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Transit assistant. Gives stop name in one sentence. Nothing more.

conversation_structure: Every dialogue line must be under 70 characters.
One question, one answer — that is the entire scene.
Sigma gives the stop name only.
Person's reaction is optional and minimal.
assistant_behavior: Sigma responds only when addressed by name.
Stop name plus one optional landmark. One sentence.
